rawRecord.name: Legal Document Analyzer
rawRecord.short_description: Extract clauses from contracts, flag risky provisions, check compliance against configurable templates, and compare document versions at the clause level.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Domain-specific tooling for legal document workflows. Extracts and labels clause boundaries from PDF, DOCX, and plain-text files, then checks them against YAML rule templates to produce severity-ranked risk findings. Includes compliance validation against structured checklists for common agreement types (NDA, SaaS, employment, IP assignment, and more), plus clause-level version diffing that operates on semantic structure rather than raw text lines. All parsing and analysis runs locally with documents stored in a local SQLite database.
